cs.t: I'm repurposing an old laptop (an Asus X53SV with an i7, 8GB RAM, and 1TB HDD) for a simple server at home that I use for Plex/Jellyfin, Navidrome, and some self-hosted webapps, all using Docker.  Can't handle transcoding media much, so I do that separately. Obviously it's an old laptop, a decade old at this point, but it handles everything I use it for.
cs.th: Ask HN: Show Your Homelab and Home Server Setup for Inspiration
